name: Klamps GTRI
summary: Klamps GTRI is a sequel to Kilofright's show called Gorilla Tag; Rise of the Infection. You can hop around explore new mechanics in each region. Help out other npc's stop ChipddBanjo's reign of terror, and have fun and hangout with your buddies! This game offers a variety of different cosmetics to choose from and do you wanna know the secret? They are free! So hop on Klamps GTRI now to experience an immersive reality while cracking cases!
